newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SLOVAK IRB 4-YR, SKK 500MLN BOND FULLY SUBSCRIBED.
newsitem.headline: SLOVAK IRB 4-YR, SKK 500MLN BOND FULLY SUBSCRIBED.

text.p: Slovakia's third largest commercial bank IRB a.s on Thursday said its 500 million crown issue of four-year bonds launched on December 6 was fully subscribed.
"The entire amount of the bond issue was successfully subscribed on the date of the issue, December 6," the bank said in a statement.
The bond carries a fixed coupon rate of 11.5 percent and each bond has a nominal value of 5,000 crowns. The money will be used to strengthen the bank's financial resources.

The statement said that investors subscribing to the bond were mainly financial institutions active on the Slovak capital market. It added that the bank would request listing of the issue on the Bratislava Stock Exchange in the near future.
Last August, IRB shareholders approved a plan to make a one billion crown issue of four-year bonds.
It was not yet clear whether the December 6 issue was a part of the plan. IRB officials were not immediately available for comment.
